format_note: This is a structured configuration projection, not a JMX-output or JTL expectation. The repository fixture validator checks the declared custom-schema identity and references; it does not execute a configuration comparator.

invariants.name: selected-keys-exact
invariants.rule: Every selected_keys list names exactly the keys present in its corresponding values map.

invariants.name: explicit-absence-disjoint
invariants.rule: Every absent_*_properties list is disjoint from its corresponding values map and records an explicit removal or remote-only absence.

invariants.name: remote-only-global-properties
invariants.rule: A -G projection is remote-only: every projected remote key is absent from both local JMeter and Java system maps in the same scenario.

invariants.name: omitted-is-not-default
invariants.rule: An unselected key is omitted, not implicitly asserted empty or default.

invariants.name: java-properties-decoding
invariants.rule: Property-file source bytes are decoded with Java Properties.load(InputStream) ISO-8859-1 semantics; literal UTF-8 effective values remain pending until oracle observation.

invariants.name: pending-evidence-no-promotion
invariants.rule: Remote projection values and locale/charset runtime values cannot promote this static corpus to observed evidence.

source_semantics.property_map_order: The logging phases above are startup ordering only; the effective property merge is -p, implicit user.properties, implicit system.properties, then remaining repeatable property options in argv order.

property_parser.empty_file_value: key is retained with an empty string
property_parser.line_continuation: an odd trailing backslash joins the next physical line and continuation indentation is ignored
